questions.cardText:
[Earth Science] If you are in Alaska right outside of the Arctic Circle, where does the sun rise and set on the summer solstice?
A. North to North
B. West to East
C. South to North
Answer: A. Just outside the Arctic Circle in Alaska, the sun travels a circular trajectory around the sky, and barely dips below the horizon on the summer solstice, resulting in almost 24 hours of daylight. This phenomenon is known as the “midnight sun.”
questions.de: In welcher Himmelsrichtung geht die Sonne in Alaska knapp südlich des Polarkreises zur Sommersonnenwende sowohl unter als auch wieder auf?
questions.en: In Alaska just south of the Arctic Circle, in which compass direction does the sun both set and rise again on the summer solstice?

timeline.labelEn: Pytheas of Massalia, active around 320 BC, becomes the first person on record to describe the midnight sun
timeline.labelDe: Pytheas von Massalia, um 320 v. Chr. tätig, beschreibt als Erster überliefert die Mitternachtssonne

source.title: Seasons and Sunsets Above the Arctic Circle: Predicting Sunsets

questions.notes: Card correct: the source says that near the Arctic at the edges of summer the Sun rises and sets almost due north; by the standard rise/set azimuth formula (cos A = sin δ / cos φ) at 65–66°N on the solstice the sun sets about 12–16° west of north and rises the same east of north, shortly after. Timeline from Wikipedia’s Pytheas article.

questions.cardText:
[Economics] How is the Gini coefficient interpreted?
A. Higher values indicate more equality
B. Higher values indicate less equality
C. The midpoint value indicates more equality
Answer: B.
questions.de: Was zeigt ein höherer Gini-Koeffizient über die Verteilung von Einkommen oder Vermögen an?
questions.en: What does a higher Gini coefficient indicate about the distribution of income or wealth?

timeline.labelEn: Corrado Gini publishes Variabilità e mutabilità, introducing his measure of inequality
timeline.labelDe: Corrado Gini veröffentlicht „Variabilità e mutabilità“ und führt sein Ungleichheitsmaß ein

questions.notes: Wikipedia: 0 = perfect equality, 1 (100%) = maximal inequality (one person has all the income).
